dissents.reason: PGR fails my test because its 40-week average is not rising, and although it sits right on the line (0.1 widths below) of a channel rising 27% a year, its weekly MACD histogram is falling, so momentum has not turned up.

LMT's 26-week channel slopes down 15% a year and its weekly MACD histogram is still falling, so whatever caused the recent drop, the chart shows a falling trend with no turn in momentum rather than a pullback in a rising channel.

At 34.2x trailing, the draft's highest multiple by almost nine turns, CAT is priced like a growth stock on cyclical heavy-machinery earnings, so its 10.45% 12-week slide has bought no margin of safety, and a hot CPI on Friday would hit the book's richest valuation hardest.
